title: PrintParams
description: Editor parameters shared verbatim by the live preview and the bake pipeline. Ranges from 01_PRODUCT_SPEC.md's editor parameter table (percent ranges expressed as fractions), defaults from 02_TECH_SPEC.md's example. schema_version 2 added the v2 personalisation block (labelling, ornaments, colours, hero buildings). schema_version 3 adds the v3 engine block (place context, per-region solid placement, colour slots/palette/tint/gradient, printer profiles, export target, terrain, heights, bridges, height exaggeration curve, auto heroes, tiling, frame styling, a hanger magnet, and two more Engraving members) for the browser engine (docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md). schema_version 4 opened with NO field here: it named the SceneGraph revision carrying the optional per-entity `name`/`osm_id`/`kind` identity that the object popover reads (docs/handoff/v3-10-objects.md). It has since gained `object_overrides`, the per-object decisions the right-click inspector writes (docs/handoff/v3-11-overrides.md), and `labels`, the names engraved into or raised off a roof or a printed surface, placed and dragged in the viewport and cut by the `labels` stage (docs/handoff/v3-12-labels.md), which is what [V3.1-O4] said would happen: a contract addition lands with the feature that claims it, not ahead of it. Every v2, v3 and v4 field is optional and defaults to the behaviour the previous version had, so a v1 payload - which carries none of them - loads unchanged.

PartColors.description: One filament colour per printed part, used when color_mode is "parts". Four distinct colours by default (base+buildings, roads+frame, water, green+trees) so a four-slot AMS prints the default scene with no re-assignment. #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA.

Engraving.description: One line of lettering on one edge of the frame. `text` runs through the shared token table (services/bake/app/geom/tokens.py, apps/web/lib/tokens.ts) before it is cut.

edge.description: Which frame edge carries the line. "underside" was added in schema_version 3 for a line on the base's underside rather than a frame edge.

mode.description: "inlay" (schema_version 3) is its own region: a second-colour solid seated in the cut rather than a cut or a raised emboss.

size_mm.description: Cap height, mm. The default is measured, not chosen: at 3.0 mm the default face refuses six of the eight strings a user actually types (v2-03 audit, finding 4); 4.0 mm cuts all of them in all three faces.

depth_mm.description: Cut depth (engrave/inlay) or raise height (emboss), mm.

NorthArrow.description: Small north indicator in one corner of the frame.

ScaleBar.description: Graphic scale bar on one frame edge.

length_mode.description: auto picks a round ground distance that fits the edge; fixed uses length_m.

length_m.description: Ground distance the bar spans when length_mode is "fixed", metres.

UndersideMark.description: Recessed provenance mark on the underside of the base.

template.description: Token template expanded by the shared token table.

Place.description: schema_version 3. Free-text location context beyond the map pin: sources for the {country}/{state}/{neighbourhood}/{author} tokens. None of these are reverse-geocoded here; a caller (or apps/web/lib/geocode.ts) fills them in.

author.description: {author} token source, e.g. for an underside or attribution line.

RoadRegion.description: schema_version 3. Solid placement for the roads region in the browser engine.

depth_mm.description: Recess depth below the base top, mm.

proud_mm.description: Height above (positive) or below (negative) the base top after the recess, mm.

WaterRegion.description: schema_version 3. Solid placement for the water region in the browser engine.

depth_mm.description: Recess depth below the base top, mm.

proud_mm.description: Height above (positive) or below (negative) the base top after the recess, mm.

ParkRegion.description: schema_version 3. Solid placement for the parks region in the browser engine.

depth_mm.description: Recess depth below the base top, mm.

proud_mm.description: Height above (positive) or below (negative) the base top after the recess, mm.

RailRegion.description: schema_version 3. Solid placement for the rail region in the browser engine.

depth_mm.description: Recess depth below the base top, mm.

proud_mm.description: Height above (positive) or below (negative) the base top after the recess, mm.

width_m.description: Ground width of the rail ribbon before the minimum-feature clamp, metres.

Regions.description: schema_version 3. Per-region solid placement for the browser engine (docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md E2). services/bake ignores this block; it drives apps/web/lib/engine/solid/{areas,roads}.ts only.

building_skirt_mm.description: Skirt width added around each building footprint before extrusion, mm.

RegionSlots.description: schema_version 3. AMS/MMU filament slot (1-16) assigned to each printed region.

RegionColors.description: schema_version 3. Filament colour swatch for each printed region, independent of part_colors (the v2 seven-part palette used by color_mode "parts"). #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA.

Tint.description: schema_version 3. Per-building colour jitter within a slot's hue, gated by colour.region_slots.

seed.description: PRNG seed, so a reload reproduces the same jitter.

Gradient.description: schema_version 3. Height-based colour gradient across a small ordered set of slots.

slots.description: Ordered slot numbers the gradient interpolates across, low buildings to high.

Colour.description: schema_version 3. Filament slot assignment, palette selection and colour effects for the browser engine's multi-material export.

palette.description: Named entry in apps/web/lib/palettes.ts, or "default" for the built-in region_colors above.

CustomProfile.description: schema_version 3. Printer geometry used when printer_profile is "custom".

change_gcode.description: G-code inserted at each filament change, single-nozzle colour-change exports only.

Terrain.description: schema_version 3. DEM heightfield draped under the base (docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md Phase 3), off by default. Exaggeration is NOT duplicated here: the existing top-level terrain_exaggeration (v1/v2, range 0.0-3.0, default 1.0) is the one exaggeration control and applies once terrain.enabled is true.

smoothing.description: Smoothing pass count applied to the heightfield.

TypeDefaults.description: schema_version 3. Fallback building height, metres, by OSM building=* value, used when heights.unknown_default_m's blanket fallback would otherwise apply.

Heights.description: schema_version 3. Building height fallback chain settings (apps/web/lib/engine/osm/heights.ts).

floor_height_m.description: Assumed storey height when only a building:levels tag is present.

unknown_default_m.description: Blanket fallback height when no tag and no type_defaults entry applies.

Bridges.description: schema_version 3. Roads tagged bridge=yes get abutments and clearance instead of draping onto the terrain/base.

clearance_mm.description: Gap left under the bridge deck, mm.

abutments.description: Print solid support columns at each bridge end.

HeightExaggeration.description: schema_version 3. Non-linear building height exaggeration curve, layered on top of small_scale/large_scale.

curve.description: 0 is linear; higher values compress tall buildings relative to short ones.

HeroAuto.description: schema_version 3. Automatic hero-building selection (apps/web/lib/heroes.ts), additive to the manual hero_building_ids list.

Tiling.description: schema_version 3. Splits the print into a grid of interlocking tiles for plates smaller than the model.

index_mark.description: Engrave a row/column index near each tile joint.

ShadowGap.description: schema_version 3. Recessed reveal between the frame and the matting/base, floating-frame look.

Matting.description: schema_version 3. Raised or flush border between the frame and the base, picture-mat look.

Separate.description: schema_version 3. Prints the frame as its own part that mates to the base after printing.

Texture.description: schema_version 3. Relief texture applied to the frame's outward-facing surface.

FrameStyle.description: schema_version 3. Frame profile, corners and add-ons, beyond the v1 flat 6 mm border.

HangerMagnet.description: schema_version 3. Recessed magnet dimensions, used when hanger is "magnets".

ObjectOverride.description: schema_version 4. One decision the user took about one OSM object in the viewport's right-click inspector (docs/handoff/v3-11-overrides.md). Keyed by the BASE OSM element id and never by the per-scene entity id: a crop that splits a way gives the parts ids with a "-N" suffix ([V3.1-P10-3]), so an id written against one crop would name nothing after the next one. Every member below defaults to "inherit its layer's behaviour", so a row carrying only osm_id and layer exports byte-identical geometry.

osm_id.description: Base OSM element id ("w123", "r45"): the value apps/web/lib/objectInfo.ts:sourceOsmId resolves for the entity, which is Building.osm_id / Road.osm_id when the crop split the way and the entity id otherwise.

layer.description: Which SceneGraph layer the id names. An override whose layer holds no such id is KEPT and reported as unresolved (EngineStats.overrides_unresolved), never dropped: a smaller crop must not destroy the decisions taken on a bigger one.

hidden.description: Leave this object out of the model entirely. It leaves no geometry AND no hole: it is removed before the layer repair, so the layers around it close over the ground it held.

height_scale.description: Buildings. Multiplies the OSM height before every other height rule, so the block/stack repair, the is_tall split and height_exaggeration all see the new number.

hero.description: Buildings. Add this building to the effective hero set or take it out, whatever hero_building_ids and hero_auto decided.

tint.description: Buildings. A shade of this building's own filament, empty for none. Preview and OBJ only, exactly like colour.tint: a printer has no way to lay down a shade of one filament.

slot.description: AMS/MMU filament slot for this object alone, 0 to keep its layer's. A non-zero value groups the object with every other object given the same printed treatment into one of the at most four override regions, and that region takes its slot from this row, with the layer's slot as the fallback ([V3.1-P11-1]); there is no per-region slot leaf to set, because a region IS the colour partition and this row is what names it.

color.description: Filament colour for this object alone, empty to keep its layer's. Like slot, it groups the object into an override region that takes its colour from this row, with the layer's colour as the fallback ([V3.1-P11-1]).

road_mode.description: Roads. This road alone engraved, embossed or left out, whatever the top-level road_mode says. "engrave" and "emboss" move it into an override region of its own; "off" removes it like hidden.

width_scale.description: Roads. Multiplies this road's ground width on top of road_scale, before the minimum-feature clamp.

raise_mm.description: Water and green. Moves this polygon's top face relative to its layer's proud_mm: negative recesses it further, positive raises it. A non-zero value moves it into an override region of its own.

Label.description: schema_version 4. One name engraved into, or raised off, a horizontal face of the model: a building's roof, or the ground surface a road, a water body or a green area prints as (docs/handoff/v3-12-labels.md). Anchored in the TARGET's own 2D frame rather than in plate coordinates, so a label survives a plate resize, a rotation and a re-fetch: u and v are fractions of the target's minimum-area oriented rectangle (for a road, u along its centreline and v across its ribbon), rotation_deg is measured from the target's principal axis, and the target is named by its BASE OSM element id exactly as ObjectOverride names one. The engine repairs every glyph with the frame lettering's own minimum-feature rules, shrinks a label to fit inside its face, and refuses one it cannot print, naming the size that would.

target_osm_id.description: Base OSM element id ("w123", "r45") of the object the label sits on: apps/web/lib/objectInfo.ts:sourceOsmId for a building or a road, AreaFeature.osm_id for water and green.

layer.description: Which SceneGraph layer the id names. A label whose target is not in the scene is kept and reported as skipped, never dropped.

surface.description: The face the text is cut into: a building's roof, or the ground surface its layer prints as (the top of the road ribbon, the water or the park). Tier A of the labels design; a vertical side face is not offered.

u.description: Position along the target's principal axis, 0 to 1 across its oriented bounding rectangle; for a road, the fraction of the centreline's length.

v.description: Position across the principal axis, 0 to 1; for a road, across the ribbon, 0.5 on the centreline.

rotation_deg.description: Reading direction relative to the target's principal axis (a road's local tangent), degrees counter-clockwise.

size_mm.description: Cap height, mm, before the fit: a label is shrunk to fit inside its face and never overhangs it.

mode.description: Cut into the face, or raised off it. An emboss prints in the target's own filament.

depth_mm.description: Cut depth (engrave) or raise height (emboss), mm.

text.description: Literal text; empty means the target's OSM name. No tokens: a label names the object it sits on.

follow.description: Roads only: set each glyph along the centreline so the name curves with the street, as a map label does. Falls back to a straight line where the curve is too tight for the glyph size; docs/handoff/v3-12-labels.md states the test.

schema_version.description: Contract revision this payload was written against. Absent means v1, which is exactly this object with every v2, v3 and v4 field at its default. schema_version 4 names the SceneGraph revision that carries the optional per-entity `name`/`osm_id`/`kind` identity, and carries the `object_overrides` and the `labels` those ids are written against ([V3.1-O4]; docs/handoff/v3-11-overrides.md, docs/handoff/v3-12-labels.md).

base_thickness_mm.description: Solid slab thickness under everything, mm.

nozzle_mm.description: Nozzle diameter, mm. Drives the minimum-feature thresholds in 04.

small_scale.description: Height multiplier for buildings under 40 m (is_tall == false).

large_scale.description: Height multiplier for buildings 40 m and over (is_tall == true).

terrain_exaggeration.description: Ignored while terrain is disabled (out of scope for the MVP).

road_scale.description: Width multiplier applied before the minimum-feature clamp in 04.

city_label.description: City name typed by the user; the only source of the {city} token. FrameCraft never reverse-geocodes.

color_mode.description: single writes one solid (v1 behaviour); parts writes one 3MF object per part, coloured from part_colors.

engravings.description: Lines of lettering on the frame, at most eight.

hanger.description: Wall-mount feature cut into the back of the base. "cleat" and "easel" were added in schema_version 3.

hero_building_ids.description: SceneGraph building ids the user singled out, at most twelve.

hero_mode.description: How a hero building differs: kept at true height, given its own colour, or both.

regions.description: schema_version 3. Per-region solid placement for the browser engine.

colour.description: schema_version 3. Filament slot assignment, palette and colour effects for the browser engine's multi-material export.

printer_profile.description: schema_version 3. Named printer geometry; "custom" uses custom_profile.

custom_profile.description: schema_version 3. Printer geometry used when printer_profile is "custom".

terrain.description: schema_version 3. DEM heightfield draped under the base. Exaggeration uses the existing top-level terrain_exaggeration field, not a field here.

heights.description: schema_version 3. Building height fallback chain settings.

bridges.description: schema_version 3. Bridge deck clearance and abutments.

height_exaggeration.description: schema_version 3. Non-linear building height exaggeration curve, on top of small_scale/large_scale.

hero_auto.description: schema_version 3. Automatic hero-building selection, additive to hero_building_ids.

tiling.description: schema_version 3. Splits the print into an interlocking tile grid.

frame_style.description: schema_version 3. Frame profile, corners and add-ons, beyond the v1 flat 6 mm border.

hanger_magnet.description: schema_version 3. Recessed magnet dimensions, used when hanger is "magnets".

object_overrides.description: schema_version 4. Per-object decisions taken in the viewport's right-click inspector, at most 24. Empty by default, so a default-constructed PrintParams exports exactly the geometry it always did. The cap is measured, not chosen: 24 overrides cost 0.8 s of the Chicago build (docs/handoff/v3-11-overrides.md section 2), which is a fifth of a cold run and the point past which the plate stops feeling live. At most four of them may ask for a printed treatment of their own (a slot, a colour, a road mode, a raise); the fifth and beyond print in their layer's own filament and say so, because four is the filament slot count of the default printer profile.

labels.description: schema_version 4. Names engraved into or raised off the model's horizontal faces, placed by direct manipulation in the viewport, at most 12. Empty by default, so a default-constructed PrintParams exports exactly the geometry it always did. The cap is measured, not chosen (docs/handoff/v3-12-labels.md section 2): each label costs a glyph repair plus one boolean against its target's region, and twelve of them keep a warm Chicago rebuild after a drag under the 400 ms preview target; the editor shows the count against the cap before it is reached.
